scientific_integrity: Explicit all-size face-potential and Kempe-component proof, two reproducible finite checkers, no independent scholarly audit.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary prisms with three named edge colours and a fixed vertex only; no all-size diameter or mixing result. Earlier degree laws and connectivity are not novelty claims. Historic unindexed adjacency classification remains possible.
title: A cycle-word model for three-edge Kempe changes on prism graphs
